headline: Not Citigroup's news: Citi is the dealer manager on another company's $2B bond buyback
reasoning: Source: Cloud Software Group's release on PR Newswire (via Morningstar), relayed by Benzinga 14:01 ET: 'Cloud Software Group Holdings, Inc. has commenced a cash tender offer to purchase up to $2 billion of its 9.00% Senior Secured Second Lien Notes due 2029 ... retained Citigroup Global Markets Inc. to serve as the dealer manager'.
What changed for Citigroup: one more advisory mandate, routine and immaterial.
objections: An adviser's role in someone else's transaction.
